scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "yarn --cwd api start:dev" "yarn --cwd web dev"
scripts.setup: node scripts/check-node.mjs && cp -n api/.env.example api/.env; podman-compose up -d && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && yarn --cwd api db:deploy && yarn --cwd api db:seed
scripts.build: yarn --cwd api build && yarn --cwd web build
scripts.demo: node scripts/check-node.mjs && yarn build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "yarn --cwd api start:prod" "yarn --cwd web start"
